verses: Haa Meem
Qasam hai uss wazeh kitab ki
Hum ney uss ko arabi zaban ka Quran banaya hai kay tum samajh lo
Yaqeenan yeh loh mehfooz mein hai aur humaray nazdeek buland martaba hikmat wali hai
Kiya hum uss naseehat ko tum say uss bana per hata len kay tum hadd say guzar janey walay log ho
Aur hum ney aglay logon mein bhi kitnay hi nabi bhejay
Jo nabi unn kay pass aaya unhon ney uss ka mazaq uraya
Pus hum ney unn say ziyadah zor aawaron ko tabah ker dala aur aglon ki misal guzar chuki hai
Agar aap unn say daryaft keren kay aasmano aur zamin ko kiss ney peda kiya to yaqeenan unn ka jawab yehi hoga kay unhen ghalib o dana (Allah) ney hi peda kiya hai
O hi hai jiss ney tumharay liye zamin ko farash (bichona) banaya aur uss mein tumharay liye raastay ker takay tum raah pa liya kero
Ussi ney aasman say aik andazay kay mutabiq pani nazil farmaya, pus hum ney uss say murdah shehar ko zindah kerdiya. Ussi tarah tum nikalay jao gay
Jiss ney tamam cheezon kay joray banaye aur tumharay liye kashtiyan banayen aur chopaye janwar (peda kiye) jin per tum sawar hotay ho

Takay tum unn ki peeth per jamm ker sawar hua kero phir apney rab ki nemat ko yaad kero jab uss per theek thaak beth jao, aur kaho pak zaat hai uss ki jiss ney ussay humaray bus mein kerdiya halankay humen ussay qaboo kerney ki taqat na thi
Aur bil-yaqeen hum apney rab ki taraf lot ker janey walay hain
Aur unhon ney Allah kay baaz bandon ko uss ka juzz thehra diya yaqeenan insan khullam khulla nashukra hai
Kiya Allah Taalaa ney apni makhlooq mein say betiyan to khud rakh len aur tumhen beton say nawaza
(halankay) unn mein say kissi ko jab uss cheez ki khabar di jaye jiss ki misal uss ney (Allah) rehman kay liye biyan ki hai to uss ka chehra siyah parr jata hai aur woh ghumgeen ho jata hai
Kiya (Allah ki aulad larkiyan hain) jo zewraat mein palen aur jhagray mein (apni baat) wazeh na saken?

Aur unhon ney farishton ko jo rehman kay ibadat guzaar hain aurten qarar dey liya. Kiya unn ki pedaeesh kay moqay per yeh mojood thay? Unn ki yeh gawahi likh li jaye gi aur unn say (uss cheez ki) baaz purs ki jaye gi
Aur kehtay hain agar Allah chahata to hum unn ki ibadat na kertay. Unhen uss ki kuch khabar nahi, yeh to sirf atkal pichoo (jhoot baaten) kehtay hain.
Kiya hum ney unhen uss say pehlay koi (aur) kitab di hai jissay yeh mazboot thamay huye hain
(nahi nahi) balkay)yeh yeh to kehtay hain kay hum ney apney baap dada ko aik mazhab per paya aur hum unhi kay naqsh-e-paa qadam per chal ker raah yafta hain

Ussi tarah aap say pehlay bhi hum ney jiss basti mein koi daraney wala bheja o haan kay aasoodah haal logon ney yehi jawab diya kay hum ney apney baap dada ko (aik raah per aur) aik deen per paya aur hum to unhi kay naqsh-e-paa paa ki pairwee kerney walay hain

(nabi ney) kaha bhi kay agarcheh mein tumharay pass uss say boht behtar (maqsood tak phonchaney wala) tareeqa ley aaya hun jiss per tum ney apney baap dadon ko paya, to unhon ney jawab diya kay hum uss kay munkir hain jissay dey ker tumhen bheja gaya hai
Pus hum ney unn say intiqam liya aur dekh ley jhutlanay walon ka kaisa anjam hua?
Aur jabkay Ibrahim (alaihi as-salam) ney apney walid say aur apni qom say farmaya kay mein unn cheezon say beyzaar hun jin ki tum ibadat kertay ho
Ba-juz uss zaat kay jiss ney mujhay peda kiya hai aur o hi mujhay hidayat bhi keray ga
Aur (Ibrahim alaihi as-salam) ussi ko apni aulad mein bhi baqi rehney wali baat qaeem ker gaye takay log (shirk say) baaz aatay rahen
Balkay)yeh mein ney unn logon ko aur unn kay baap dadon ko saman (aur asbaab) diya, yahan tak kay unn kay pass haq aur saaf saaf sunaney wala rasool aagaya
Aur haq kay phonchtay hi yeh bol paray kay yeh to jadoo hai aur hum uss kay munkir hain
Aur kehney lagay, yeh Quran unn dono bastiyon mein say kissi baray aadmi per kiyon na nazil kiya gaya

Kiya aap kay rab ki rehmat ko yeh taqseem kertay hain? Hum ney hi unn ki zindagani duniya ki rozi unn mein taqseem ki hai aur aik ko doosray say buland kiya hai takay aik doosray ko ma-tehat ker ley jissay yeh log samettay phirtay hain uss say aap kay rab ki rehmat boht hi behtar hai

Aur agar yeh baat na hoti kay tamam log aik hi tareeqa per ho jayen gay to rehman kay sath kufur kerney walon kay gharon ki chaton ko hum chandi ki bana detay. Aur zeenon ko (bhi) jin per charha kertay
Aur unn kay gharon kay darwazay aur takht bhi jin per woh takiya laga laga ker bethtay
Aur soney kay bhi, aur yeh sab kuch yunhi sa duniya ki zindagi ka faeedah hai aur aakhirat to aap kay rab kay nazdeek (sirf) perhezgaron kay liye (hi) hai.
Aur jo shakhs rehman ki yaad say ghaflat keray hum uss per aik shetan muqarrar ker detay hain o hi uss ka sathi rehta hai
Aur woh unhen raah say roktay hain aur yeh ussi khayal mein rehtay hain kay yeh hidayat yafta hain
Yahan tak kay jab woh humaray pass aaye ga kahey ga kaash! meray aur teray darmiyan mashriq aur maghrib ki doori hoti (to) bara bura sathi hai
Aur jab kay tum zalim thehar chukay to tumhen aaj hergiz tum sab ka azab mein shareek hona koi nafa na dey ga
Kiya pus to behray ko suna sakta hai ya andhay ko raah dikha sakta hai aur ussay jo khulli gumrahi mein ho
Pus agar hum tujhay yahan say ley bhi jayen to bhi hum unn say badla lenay walay hain
Ya jo kuch unn say wada kiya hai woh tujhay dikha den hum unn per bhi qudrat rakhtay hain
Pus jo wahee aap ki taraf ki gaee hai ussay mazboot thamay rahen be-shak aap raah raast per hain
Aur yaqeenan yeh (khud) aap kay liye aur aap ki qom kay liye naseehat hai aur unqareeb tum log poochay jao gay
Aur humaray unn nabiyon say poocho! jinhen hum ney aap say pehlay bheja tha kay kiya hum ney siwaye rehman kay aur mabood muqarrar kiye thay jin ki ibadat ki jaye?
Aur hum ney Musa (alaihi as-salam) ko apni nishaniyan dey ker Firaun aur uss kay umraa kay pass bheja to (Musa alaihi as-salam ney ker) kaha kay mein tamam jahano kay rab ka rasool hun
Pus jab woh humari nishaniyan ley ker unn kay pass aaye to woh be-saakhta unn per hansney lagay
Aur hum unhen jo nishani dikhatay thay woh doosri say barhi charhi hoti thi aur hum ney unhen azab mein pakra takay woh baaz aajayen
Aur unhon ney kaha aey jadoogar! humaray liye apney rab say uss ki dua ker jiss ka uss ney tujh say wada ker rakha hai, yaqeen maan kay hum raah per lag jayen gay
Phir jab hum ney woh azab unn say hata unhon ney ussi waqt apna qol o qarar tor diya
Aur Firaun ney apni qom mein munadi keraee aur kaha aey meri qom! kiya misir ka mulk mera nahi? Aur meray (mehlon kay) neechay yeh nehren beh rahi hain, kiya tum dekhtay nahi?
Balkay)yeh mein behtar hun ba nisbat uss kay jo be-toqeer hai aur saaf bol bhi nahi sakta
Acha uss per soney kay kanggan kiyon nahi paray ya uss kay sath per bandh ker farishtay hi aajatay
Uss ney apni qom ko behlaya phuslaya aur unhon ney ussi ki maan li, yaqeenan yeh saray hi nafarman log thay
Phir jab unhon ney humen ghussa dilaya to hum ney unn say intiqam liya aur sab ko dobo diya
Pus hum ney unhen gaya guzra kerdiya aur pichlon kay liye misal bana
Aur jab ibn Maryam ki misal biyan ki gaee to uss say teri qom (khushi say) cheekhney lagi hai
Aur unhon ney kaha kay humaray mabood achay hain ya woh? Tujh say unn ka yeh kehna mehaz jhagray ki gharz say hai, balkay)yeh yeh log hain hi jhagraloo
Isa (alaihi as-salam) bhi sirf bandah hi hai jiss per hum ney ehsan kiya aur ussay bani israeel kay liye nishan qudrat banaya
Agar hum chahatay to tumharay ewaz farishtay ker detay jo zamin mein janasheeni kertay
Aur yaqeenan Isa (alaihi as-salam) qayamat ki alamat hai pus tum (qayamat) kay baray mein shak na kero aur meri tabeydaari kero, yehi seedhi raah hai
Aur shetan tumhen rok na dey, yaqeenan woh tumhara sareeh dushman hai

Aur jab Isa (alaihi as-salam) moajzzay ko laye to kaha. Kay mein tumharay pass hikmat laya hun aur uss liye aaya hun kay jin baaz cheezon mein tum mukhtalif ho, unhen wazeh kerdoon, pus tum Allah Taalaa say daro aur mera kaha mano
Mera aur tumhara rab faqat Allah Taalaa hi hai. Pus tum sab uss ki ibadat kero. Raah raast (yehi) hai
Phir (bani israeel ki) jamaton ney aapas mein ikhtilaf kiya, pus zalimon kay liye kharabi hai dukh walay din ki aafat say
Yeh log sirf qayamat kay muntazir hain kay woh achanak unn per paray aur unhen khabar bhi na ho
Uss din (gehray) dost bhi aik doosray kay dushman bann jayen gay siwaye perhezgaron kay
Meray bando! aaj to tum per koi khof (o o-hiras) hai aur na tum (bad dil aur) ghumzadah hogay
Jo humari aayaton per eman laye aur thay bhi woh (farman bardaar) musalman
Tum aur tumhari biwiyan hashash bashash (razi khushi) jannat mein chalay jao

Unn kay charon taraf say soney ki rakabiyan aur soney kay gilason ka door chalaya jaye ga, unn kay ji jiss cheez ki khuwahish keren aur jiss say unn ki aankhen lazzat payen, sab o haan hoga aur tum uss mein hamesha raho gay
Yehi woh bahisht hai kay tum apney aemaal kay badlay uss kay waris banaye gaye ho
Yahan tumharay liye ba-kasrat meway hain jinhen tum khatay raho gay
Be-shak gunehgar log azab dozakh mein hamesha rahen gay
Yeh azab kabhi bhi unn say halka na kiya jaye ga aur woh ussi mein mayyus paray rahen gay
Aur hum ney unn per zulm nahi kiya balkay)yeh yeh khud hi zalim thay
Aur pukar pukar ker kahen gay kay aey malik! tera rab humara kaam hi tamam kerdey, woh kahey ga kay tumhen to (hamesha) rehna hai
Hum to tumharay pass haq ley aaye lekin tum mein say aksar log haq say nafrat rakhney walay thay?
Kiya unhon ney kissi kaam ka pukhta iradah kerliya hai to yaqeen mano kay hum bhi pukhta kaam kerney walay hain

Kiya unn ka yeh khayal hai kay hum unn ki posheedah baaton ko aur unn ki sirgoshiyon ko nahi suntay, (yaqeenan hum barabar sunn rahey hain) balkay)yeh humaray bhejay huye unn kay pass hi likh rahey hain
Aap keh dijiye! kay agar bil-farz rehman ki aulad ho to mein sab say pehlay ibadat kerney wala hota
Aasmano aur zamin aur arsh ka rab jo kuch yeh biyan kertay hain uss say (boht) pak hai
Abb aap unhen ussi behas mubahisay aur khel kood mein chor dijiye, yahan tak kay unhen uss din say sabiqa parr jin ka yeh wada diye jatay hain
O hi aasmano mein mabood hai aur zamin mein bhi o hi qabil ibadat hai aur woh bari hikmat wala aur pooray ilm wala hai
Aur woh boht barkaton wala hai jiss kay pass aasman o zamin aur unn kay darmiyan ki badshahat hai, aur qayamat ka ilm bhi ussi kay pass hai aur ussi ki janib tum sab lotaye jao gay
Jinhen yeh log Allah kay siwa pukartay hain woh shifaat kerney ka ikhtiyar nahi rakhtay, haan (mustahiq shifaat woh hain) jo haq baat ka iqrar keren aur unhen ilm bhi ho
Agar aap unn say daryaft keren kay unhen kiss ney peda kiya hai? To yaqeenan yeh jawab den gay kay Allah ney, phir yeh kahan ultay jatay hain?
Aur unn ka (payghumbar ka aksar) yeh kehna kay aey meray rab! yaqeenan yeh woh log hain jo eman nahi latay
Pus aap unn say mun pher len aur keh den. (acha bhai) salam! unhen unqareeb (khud hi) maloom hojaye ga
